narr: Abundant gulf moisture streamed northward across the central US in between high pressure over the mid Atlantic and low pressure over the southwest US. Heavy rainfall occurred over central and southwest Missouri from the evening of the 17th to the morning of the 18th. Rainfall accumulations of two to five inches led to flash flooding in Marionville and Verona in Lawrence County. Homes were flooded in Marionville and Highway 60 flooded. In Verona, five people had to be rescued off their roof. Additional flash flooding occurred near Pleasant Hope and Eudora in Polk County, near Billings in Christian County, and along Kelly Creek in Monett, in Barry County.
